intent: GET /users endpoint returns a paginated list of ALL users matching the query. Requires valid Bearer auth token. Returns 401 for invalid/missing tokens. Supports offset and limit query parameters for pagination.

ERC-20 token transfer function. Transfers tokens from sender to recipient. Must decrease sender balance, increase recipient balance, emit Transfer event. Must prevent transfers exceeding sender balance. Must be safe against reentrancy.

Role-based access control system. Admin users can create/delete users. Regular users can only view their own profile. Authentication tokens must be valid and not expired. Failed login attempts must be rate-limited.

User registration system. Each user has unique email, hashed password, created_at timestamp. Email must be case-insensitive unique (no two users with same email differing only by case). Passwords must never be stored in plaintext.
